check /Users/kenneth/Projects/JusPrin/llm-provider-design.md . then the 1st task: Do rollout step 1 of llm-provider-design.md (repo root, untracked; read it first, in full): split OpenAIResponsesAgent into a provider-neutral turn loop plus a Responses-API codec plus a provider profile, with no behaviour change.

Files: src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/Agent/OpenAIResponsesAgent.{hpp,cpp}, OpenAIHttpTransport.cpp, AgentSetup.{hpp,cpp}, AgentConfiguration.cpp, and tests/agent/test_openai_responses_agent.cpp. The shell harness (tests/shell/shell_harness.cpp, project_prompt_scenario.inc) and tests/agent/test_agent_setup.cpp and test_printer_conversation.cpp also name the class.

What to build:
1. ProviderAgent (new files, e.g. Agent/ProviderAgent.{hpp,cpp}): the turn loop, taken from OpenAIResponsesAgent.cpp unchanged in behaviour. It owns a neutral TurnTranscript (instructions, tools offered, opening conversation and this turn's user content, then one step per response: an opaque assistant_turn JSON, the results with their images, and the once-only skill items). It keeps every rule the current class enforces: calls run one at a time in order, a failed call answers the rest unrun, unknown or invalid calls are refused back at most twice per turn, images follow results, skills ride on one request only, usage to the listener, late events dropped by generation, SSE framing.
2. IProviderCodec + ResponsesCodec (e.g. Agent/ProviderCodec.hpp, Agent/ResponsesCodec.{hpp,cpp}): build(transcript, profile, kind) -> body JSON and headers; parse(sse data payload) -> neutral events (TextDelta, TurnComplete{assistant_turn, calls, usage}, Incomplete, Failed). Pure, no network, no GUI. The assistant_turn is the raw output[] of the response; the loop never looks inside it.
3. ProviderProfile (data): family, endpoint, auth header style, default model, display name for error text. One row for openai with today's values. AgentHttpRequest carries a header list instead of a single authorization string; update the transport and the FakeTransport in the tests accordingly.
4. Keep `OpenAIResponsesAgent` and `OpenAIResponsesConfig` as thin aliases or wrappers so the harness, AgentSetup and AgentConfiguration compile unchanged in this step. Do not add Anthropic or OpenRouter in this step.

Done means:
- Every test in tests/agent passes (build in build/arm64, see memory note "Worktree build recipe" if in a worktree; ctest --test-dir build/arm64/tests/agent or the equivalent).
- Request bodies are byte-identical before and after: before refactoring, run the adapter tests and the shell harness mode that records request bodies (--project-prompt-requests, see shell_harness.cpp around line 635 and 670) and keep the output; after refactoring, diff. tests/project_prompt/requests.json is the oracle for the Responses wire shape and must still validate against the registry (test "the project prompt tests' recorded tool results match the registry's output schemas").
- The 33 adapter tests are split into loop tests (run against ProviderAgent with a scripted fake codec) and Responses wire tests, keeping every existing assertion.
- No change to AgentHost, ToolRegistry, ToolExecutionCoordinator, the MCP code, or anything outside src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/Agent and tests/agent and tests/shell.
- Commit on your own branch with a message a cold reader understands. Do not commit llm-provider-design.md or any handoff doc.
